explanation: The Barker conjecture: there is no Barker sequence (±1 entries, |C_k| ≤ 1 for 0 < k < n) of length greater than 13. The aperiodic autocorrelation Σ a_i a_{i+k} is computed correctly via zipWith with drop k. Test lemmas confirm the known length-13 and length-4 examples. The statement is faithful and open (Willms; Wikipedia).
